WITH s AS (
    SELECT setting_num('deal_threshold_pct')  AS threshold,
           setting_num('suspicious_deal_pct') AS suspicious,
           setting_num('min_price_samples')   AS min_samples
),
candidates AS (
    -- asking prices seen in the last 2 days that we have not flagged before
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (mp.source, mp.external_id)
           mp.*,
           fair_price(mp.reference, mp.condition, COALESCE(mp.box_papers, FALSE)) AS fair
    FROM market_prices mp
    JOIN source_weights sw ON sw.source = mp.source AND sw.price_type = 'asking'
    WHERE mp.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '2 days'
      AND mp.price_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM deals d JOIN market_prices m2 ON m2.id = d.market_price_id
          WHERE m2.source = mp.source AND m2.external_id = mp.external_id)
    ORDER BY mp.source, mp.external_id, mp.observed_on DESC
),
new_deals AS (
    INSERT INTO deals (market_price_id, fair_usd, price_usd, discount_pct, suspicious)
    SELECT c.id, c.fair, c.price_usd,
           ROUND((1 - c.price_usd / c.fair) * 100, 1),
           (1 - c.price_usd / c.fair) * 100 > s.suspicious
    FROM candidates c
    CROSS JOIN s
    JOIN v_fair_prices v ON v.reference = c.reference AND v.samples >= s.min_samples
    WHERE c.fair > 0
      AND c.price_usd <= c.fair * (1 - s.threshold / 100)
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT d.discount_pct, d.suspicious, d.price_usd, d.fair_usd,
       mp.source, mp.seller, mp.brand, mp.reference, mp.title, mp.condition,
       mp.price, mp.currency, mp.country, mp.url,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'owner_email') AS owner_email,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM new_deals d
JOIN market_prices mp ON mp.id = d.market_price_id
ORDER BY d.discount_pct DESC;

parameters.content:
## Deal finder
Every hour, compares new asking prices with the **fair price** (SQL function `fair_price()`). Anything more than `deal_threshold_pct` (default 12%) below is saved in `deals` and emailed to you.

Deals far too cheap (`suspicious_deal_pct`, 40%) are marked - these are often fakes or scams.
